title: Speak to Harmony about Floyd

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: Oh how lovely to see you again!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh how lovely to see you again!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can I ask you a personal question?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can I ask you a personal question?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Can I ask you a personal question?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Can I ask you a personal question?

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: I don't see why not!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't see why not!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: As a child, you had an accident?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As a child, you had an accident?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: As a child, you had an accident?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: As a child, you had an accident?

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: Oh yes, awful business. Pinned under a rogue Hova! If it weren't for the kindness of a stranger, I'd be part of the sidewalk.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh yes, awful business. Pinned under a rogue Hova! If it weren't for the kindness of a stranger, I'd be part of the sidewalk.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A stranger?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A stranger?

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: I was young and had quite a lot of Hova car on me, so my memory is hazy. My parents always advised me against looking into who it was. I never knew why.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I was young and had quite a lot of Hova car on me, so my memory is hazy. My parents always advised me against looking into who it was. I never knew why.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think I know who it was.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think I know who it was.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think I know who it was.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think I know who it was.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: Really?! Oh you must tell me. I've wondered for years.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Really?! Oh you must tell me. I've wondered for years.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: His name is Floyd, he's a local android.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: His name is Floyd, he's a local android.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: His name is Floyd, he's a local android.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: His name is Floyd, he's a local android.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: Floyd, the Mechatomb guy? You're kidding!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Floyd, the Mechatomb guy? You're kidding!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, I'm not kidding.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, I'm not kidding.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: Of course! That makes complete sense. Oh I wish I'd have known. I've been selling him electro-supplements for years!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course! That makes complete sense. Oh I wish I'd have known. I've been selling him electro-supplements for years!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe you could offer him a discount?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe you could offer him a discount?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe you could offer him a discount?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe you could offer him a discount?

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: A discount? No, from now on, it's on the house. Oh I must speak to him. Thank you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A discount? No, from now on, it's on the house. Oh I must speak to him. Thank you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're welcome.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're welcome.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you remember who it was?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you remember who it was?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do you remember who it was?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do you remember who it was?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Would you be interested to find out?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Would you be interested to find out?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Would you be interested to find out?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Would you be interested to find out?

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: Of course! I owe that person my life!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course! I owe that person my life!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: May I ask you something personal?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: May I ask you something personal?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: May I ask you something personal?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: May I ask you something personal?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He's the last of the Roid Droids. It's how he was able to lift the Hova off you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He's the last of the Roid Droids. It's how he was able to lift the Hova off you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: He's the last of the Roid Droids. It's how he was able to lift the Hova off you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: He's the last of the Roid Droids. It's how he was able to lift the Hova off you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe you could have a chat. I'm sure he would love that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe you could have a chat. I'm sure he would love that.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe you could have a chat. I'm sure he would love that.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe you could have a chat. I'm sure he would love that.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: Oh I must speak to him as soon as I can. Thank you so much! Oh... but how did you find out?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh I must speak to him as soon as I can. Thank you so much! Oh... but how did you find out?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ava, my Automata. She's a real detective.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ava, my Automata. She's a real detective.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Ava, my Automata. She's a real detective.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Ava, my Automata. She's a real detective.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: What are you doing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Making you famous, Ava.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Making you famous, Ava.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: You mean us? I only really exist in your head.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You mean us? I only really exist in your head.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Us, yes. And I don't think that's true.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Us, yes. And I don't think that's true.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Us, yes. And I don't think that's true.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Us, yes. And I don't think that's true.
